title: Open-source IDE and developer tool bundle
policy: Installed packages are built from Debian's signed repositories. Package installation is not a claim that every project language or target SDK is preconfigured.
note: The base IDE set is installed from Debian signed packages. Optional IDEs are installed when their package is present in the configured Debian Trixie repository. The build records the exact installed package/version inventory in ide-packages-installed.tsv. Packages are not rebuilt from source during ISO mastering; upstream Debian package builds supply the binaries.
